description:
🛑 Stop doing THESE if you own a home — they could be draining your wallet without you knowing 💸

🧾 Skipping receipts for upgrades?
No paper trail = no proof of value when you sell.

🌳 Letting tree limbs hang over your roof?
They cause leaks, pests, and costly roof damage.

🎨 Going bold everywhere?
Trendy doesn’t always mean timeless — choose wisely!

🔥 Running the dryer unattended?
Lint + heat + no supervision = major fire risk.

⚡️ DIY electrical without permits?
Cheap now, expensive later — in both repairs and safety.

💧 Ignoring small leaks?
Water spreads faster than you think.

🎭 Painting over stains?
You’re just hiding a problem that’ll come back worse.

🌿 Neglecting curb appeal?
Buyers always judge the exterior first.

🌬️ Skipping HVAC service?
That $100 check-up can save you thousands later.

🚫 Sealing off windows?
Natural light and air matter more than you realize.

💡 A little prevention now = peace of mind later!
Follow for more real-life homeowner lessons from your Texas Realtor 🏡
